acceptanceCriteria: A fixture repository with bun:test unit and integration suites is selected by affected, executed by the provider and admitted as a receipt that joins to test-validity verdicts the same way vitest receipts do.
Receipt carries producer build identity, bun version, lockfile digest, clean-before/after tree state and the exact command including --preload and concurrency flags.
An unqualified bun version or lockfile produces a distinct typed refusal code; focused tests via heavy.sh; Closes #1405.
body: GitHub #1405: affected selection classifies TypeScript tests importing bun:test as runner bun (internal/liveverify/affected/typescript), but cmd/corvint-js-test-provider declares runner profiles only for vitest and playwright, so bun suites get a selection Corvint cannot execute or receipt. Requested: a bun runner profile with the vitest guarantees: example-level selection and per-example located results; receipt with producer build identity, bun version, lockfile digest, clean before/after tree state and exact command (including --preload and concurrency flags); preload plus caller-started external service under a declared-isolation profile; a distinct refusal code for an unqualified bun version or lockfile.
title: GH #1405: JS test provider executes and receipts bun test suites (runner bun already detected by selection)
